note: Because ADR-0500 withdrew the URL-in-`--database` spelling, put the remote bundle on `--load <url>` (a bare http(s) URL in --database is a usage error), reusing ADR-0496's GitHub rewrite, https/.cl policy and capped streaming scratch fetch, and treat the download as a scratch copy released after load.

The `query` verb already exists as a statement-session command with `-d/--database`, so the work is to extend or verify that behavior rather than add a second one, keeping the TTY-shell behavior and the did-you-mean and multi-statement failure reporting intact.

Add the new procedure with the ADR-0227 signature style (no database argument), registered in the always-built ontology crate and listed in SHOW PROCEDURES, gated behind the CYPHERLITE_PREVIEW=ontology preview feature, honoring the implicit/explicit transaction rules, and never exposing a system_ontologies graph surface.

The re-arrival rule and its work bound already exist, so any extension must use the tri-state verdict with run-time fall-through to the DFS (ADR-0516) and the sparse table accounting (ADR-0521) rather than ADR-0478 §3 and §6, while staying inside the answer-shape gate.

Serve and the MCP binary open the store read-only or following through the single `--read-only[=snapshot|live]` flag (ADR-0480 replaced `--follow` and the valueless-flag Docker pass-through), sharing one handle across surfaces, with the Docker entrypoint forwarding it to `cypherlite serve`.
The `snapshot` verb was removed in favor of `cypherlite clone SOURCE DEST`, which already covers dir to `.cl` and back, so use or extend clone rather than adding a new verb.
